offering_description.value: Provides electric power, broadband internet, and telephone service to Alaska communities, including homes and businesses. It delivers connectivity over regional fiber networks and offers custom data services to businesses.

quotes.quote: We are an employee-owned utility dedicated to serving over 40 Alaska communities with reliable power, broadband, and telephone services. we’ve built our reputation on trust, innovation, and a deep commitment to the people and places we serve.

At AP&T, we provide the advanced connectivity and energy solutions businesses need to thrive. From high-speed broadband and custom data services to reliable telephone and energy services, our business solutions are built on cutting edge infrastructure—including regional fiber networks and 24/7 support.
At AP&T, we provide large commercial consumers with bulk power rates regulated by the Regulatory Commission of Alaska (RCA).
Our energy is generated through a dependable mix of diesel generation and hydroelectric plants, ensuring both stability and sustainability.
